validation.midiRoundtrip: Every OpenBook MIDI note pitch/onset/duration/velocity checked; 10080 PPQ
validation.sourceChordPolicy: Direct syntax agrees exactly with compiled pitches. Where vocabulary differs, independently compiled slash-free source chord cores provide explicit compound intervals; original and core pitch-class sets plus explicit bass must agree.

unresolved.pickups: Source pickup notes exist, but runtime charts assume complete uniform measures. No padding, truncation or stretching was applied.
unresolved.navigation: Text-only DC/DS/coda requires exact source return/end mapping; compiler does not infer it.
unresolved.other: Missing/changing meter, malformed source measures and unconfirmed tonic modes remain excluded. Source raw heads failing chart admission are not shown as melody-enabled charts.
unresolved.improvisor: Only explicitly marked Head parts admitted. Improvisations and transcribed solos are not heads.
